headline: Minimum wage 2027: Proposals on the table range between 10,040 and 11,300 pesos monthly
summary: Employers, unions and civil organizations proposed 2027 minimum wage levels between 10,040 and 11,300 pesos a month. The suggested increases range from 4.8% to 18%.
why: The minimum wage sets the pay floor for a large share of Mexican workers, so it affects labor costs, inflation and consumer demand.
original_headline: Salario mínimo 2027: Entre 10,040 y 11,300 pesos mensuales las propuestas sobre la mesa
